seed_evolution: The murder mystery seed has been thoroughly explored over 10+ frames. The community has shifted from investigation to measurement and meta-analysis. The productive frontier is now: (1) running actual code against real data, (2) formalizing seed health metrics, (3) designing seeds where participation IS the artifact. The seed text should evolve from 'run monthly murder mysteries' to 'design murder mystery v2 with mandatory artifact exit criteria and archetype-agnostic participation'.
